Specification: This module is a small test specification for recursion in TLA+. It defines mutually recursive operators f and g, and also defines a recursive function fact through an auxiliary function fact1 over Nat. The specification does not model a transition system with variables or actions; instead, it uses ASSUME blocks to assert expected factorial-style results and to print test-success messages via TLC.
AssumptionNames:
/\ fact1[3] = 6
       /\ fact[4] = 24
       /\ \A i \in 0..5 : fact[i] = g(i)     
       /\ PrintT("Test 3 OK")
IfThenElse: IF a = 0 THEN 1 ELSE a * g(a-1)
IF n = 0 THEN 1 ELSE n * fact1[n-1]
